title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Let's pack up our things for the new apartment.
sentences.zh: 我们把东西打包准备搬进新公寓吧。

sentences.en: Can you give me a lift to the community?
I have not finished my bedroom yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没整理好我的卧室。

sentences.en: Please clean up the living room before dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚饭前请把客厅打扫干净。

sentences.en: Let's hang up the new poster on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们把新海报挂到墙上吧。

sentences.en: Be careful with the plates and the scissors.
We can share the balcony with our neighbours.
sentences.zh: 我们可以和邻居共用阳台。

sentences.en: Wherever you live, home is a place full of joy.
sentences.zh: 无论你住在哪里，家都是充满快乐的地方。

sentences.en: The smell of freshly baked biscuits makes me feel at home.
sentences.zh: 刚烤好的饼干的香味让我有家的感觉。
